svg.title: Median formula size versus network size
svg.desc: Width 16 at length 10: 274 independent form coefficients versus 288 network parameters. Width 32 at length 10: 1056 versus 1088. These forms are not compression claims. Finite-sample fidelity is not all-domain exactness. Source: atlas entry (research report), https://github.com/jc1122/mechanistic-interpretability-circuit-atlas/blob/main/entries/algzoo-median.md.

g.text: An identified formula need not be short
